import sys
import itertools

class ERockPaperScissors:
    def __init__(self):
        self.minDiff = float('inf')

    def evaluate(self, pairs, a, b):
        a_copy = a[:]
        b_copy = b[:]
        for p in pairs:
            m = min(a_copy[p[0]], b_copy[p[1]])
            b_copy[p[1]] -= m
            a_copy[p[0]] -= m
        total = sum(a_copy)
        self.minDiff = min(self.minDiff, total)

    def generatePermutations(self, pairs, start, a, b):
        self.evaluate(pairs, a, b)
        for i in range(start, len(pairs)):
            pairs[start], pairs[i] = pairs[i], pairs[start]
            self.generatePermutations(pairs, start + 1, a, b)
            pairs[start], pairs[i] = pairs[i], pairs[start]

    def play(self, br, pw):
        n = int(br.readline())
        a = list(map(int, br.readline().split()))
        b = list(map(int, br.readline().split()))
        self.minDiff = float('inf')
        maxScore = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])
        pairs = [
            [0, 0],
            [1, 1],
            [2, 2],
            [0, 2],
            [1, 0],
            [2, 1]
        ]
        self.generatePermutations(pairs, 0, a, b)
        pw.write(str(self.minDiff) + " " + str(maxScore) + "\n")

def main():
    br = sys.stdin
    pw = sys.stdout
    game = ERockPaperScissors()
    game.play(br, pw)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
